checks_run.procedure: Judge D-171's observations (a) to (g). For each one in my focus, accept it with a reason or raise a finding.
checks_run.command: Source review: kpi/formula-versions.ts, kpi/benefit-formulas.ts, 0023; methodology/migrations.ts, 0064, ADR-0040 §4; procedures/instances.ts, steps.ts, grep subject_record_id; web gates i18n and readiness; packages/db/src/demo/data/roaming-gates.ts
checks_run.environment: Repository tree at b147dda
checks_run.expected: A reasoned judgement of each observation.

All are accepted; none is a defect in my focus.
(a) The benefit_formula review path: ACCEPTED. A formula version is immutable once inserted (0023 benefit_formula_version_freeze: only the validation columns, version and updated_* move). Its variables are append-only and inserted only in the single-author creation (benefit-formulas.ts:339-362). The validator is never created_by (CHECK benefit_formula_version_validator_not_author; formula-versions.ts:152). So no co-editor path exists.
(b) methodology_migration approval: ACCEPTED as designed. It is a business approval (methodology_migration.approve, SP only, 0064:24; plan is ADM_METHOD only, 0064:33), and its SoD is the uniform canonical requester_excluded plus the submitter (migrations.ts:687; ADR-0040 §4; ADR-0026 §4). The residual: a person holding ADM_METHOD who is also the mapped Sponsor can re-plan inputs and then approve as Sponsor. That is the accountable Sponsor deciding on content the plan shows, not a configuration self-review. It is for the business access policy, not a code defect.
(c) The launch subjectRecordId: ACCEPTED. It is stored opaquely (instances.ts:318) and echoed only to instance readers (steps.ts:1186). It is never resolved by the API, the adapters or the worker. It discloses and grants nothing.
(d) and (e), FE-V1B wording ('the other 1 are covered'; the blocked banner not naming coverage): cosmetic English text with no security or integrity effect. The strings are interpolated by i18next and React, which escape them. I leave their wording to the domain and qa reviewers.
(f) The bare DG2-DG4 .table-wrap: an accessibility matter for qa, with no security effect.
(g) BE-V3's demo G4 rests on two accepted exceptions, and no gate.* outbox events are written: ACCEPTED. The seed writes through the product's own tables and guards with audit events, and every decision is labelled 'Synthetic demonstration - approves nothing real'. Seeding remains refused in production (demo guard.ts unchanged, 08-scans §6). Skipping the outbox avoids real-clock tasks, so no automation can act on a demo approval. The phase-step enablement is seeded consistently (roaming-states.ts). The demo-gate-history test passed in both runs.
